title: family-expense-bot
summary: Telegram bot that turns free-text expenses into structured records. The LLM extracts and quotes; deterministic rules validate every field, and nothing is saved until a person confirms. Same logic re-implemented as an n8n agent.
previewAlt: Budget Mini App screens with synthetic data: monthly pockets, a 'can I spend this?' check and an expense confirmation

title: WC_predictor
summary: National-team football predictor, born for the 2026 World Cup. Pydantic-contracted ETL, StatsBomb xG, a Dixon-Coles model and Monte Carlo simulation, backtested against Elo and betting odds. The LLM is an optional narrator.
previewAlt: WC_predictor website home: dark football-pitch layout with the 2026-27 season headline

title: internship-matcher
summary: CLI that compares a LaTeX CV against a job posting. The LLM extracts requirements with verified literal quotes; a deterministic layer over a YAML vocabulary computes the coverage.

title: power-factor-analyzer
summary: ETL over industrial electricity bills (CFE, Mexico): power factor, capacitor sizing and ROI, exported to Excel. Started in a COIL project with Tec de Monterrey and Kiin Energy. Sample data is fictitious.
previewAlt: Bar and line chart of power factor per billing period for two fictitious clients, against the 0.90 and 0.95 thresholds

title: MetalurgicaAndina_QC
summary: ETL pipeline for messy production data with a report that quantifies every cleaning decision. Ambiguous dates fail fast instead of being guessed. Class case study (IIN2002).

title: sistema-eventos
summary: Music event management system built by a team of three.

title: Tennis Session Tracker
summary: REST API to log training sessions and matches: type, duration, intensity, energy before and after, gym exercises and results.
